args.body: Advance SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATION-SHELF-TEST under a valid lease if no equivalent verdict exists. The initial storefront URL returned HTTP 404. Use the new discovery capture if committed solely to locate up to three first-party listings, within the existing mission allowance. Compare the actual scope and displayed prices with the short SQLite exercise. Count sales evidence only where the listing explicitly supplies it. Use the official royalties capture if readable and within the mission allowance. Finish the private listing draft only if the comparable and policy evidence support it, leaving exact-archive rights, activation and payout prerequisites explicit. Otherwise record the bounded coverage and specific evidence that would reopen the channel. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. No signup or publication.

description: Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, but five unclassified sources leave buyer demand unknown. The Leanpub search returned HTTP 404, which limits discovery through that URL. Check the official author terms and use a separate discovery query to find first-party listings comparable to the short SQLite exercise. A close comparable and documented seller terms would justify a private listing draft. Activation also depends on rights for the exact archive and confirmed seller eligibility. Independently, turn the completed CanadaBuys screens into a bounded evidence record for the assigned agent to read before closing the mission.
